about: Top-down plane shapes from VRS Custom Markers by rikgale (github.com/rikgale/VRSCustomMarkers), forked from shish0r/VRSCustomMarkers. CC0 1.0: free for any use. Thank you!
own: Shapes starting TPA_ (Wildcat, Puma, Juno/Jupiter, Black Hawk, Tutor, Shadow, Voyager, 737/Poseidon, Hercules) were drawn for TPA (v4/tools/tpa_plane_shapes_own.py), also CC0. milCodes are used only for military planes.
